identity_rule: One record per unique CVE ID. No record quarantine from shared URLs, descriptions, original descriptions or posts. This is CVE-disjoint, not established vulnerability-family-disjoint evaluation.
source_overlap_rule: Keep descriptions. Keep all nonempty training documents passing the existing Day-60 source adapter. Mask only optional validation documents whose lowercased whitespace-normalized text occurs in any accepted training source. Apply the same training registry in smoke and full exports; never use validation content to alter training.
future_test_rule: Test export remains disabled. A later test adapter must screen optional documents against the frozen training and retained-validation text registries, report description overlap, and keep all eligible test CVEs.
summary_quality_rule: No new factuality/quality filter. Retain imperfect nonempty summaries; preserve original text. Missing optional sources never exclude a CVE.
historical_scope: Retrospective text fusion; stored post-date screening does not authenticate historical content availability.
